logs.page.title: Logs
logs.page.subtitle: View app events, requests and configuration changes. Full records are saved in your log folder.
logs.clear_all_hint: Delete history and empty the current log. Recording continues. This cannot be undone.
logs.clear_view_hint: Only clear the view buffer; keep log files
logs.table_hint: Select rows and press Ctrl+C to copy. Hover over a cell to see the full text.
logs.missing_history: {name} (file may be removed; showing loaded preview)
logs.open_failed: Cannot open the folder. Copy this path: {path}
logs.clear_prompt:
Delete all previous session logs and empty the current log?

This cannot be undone. The current log file is kept and recording resumes immediately. Settings and other data are unaffected.
logs.state.live: Viewing live logs for this session
logs.state.limited: {status} · Showing the end only; open the file for full contents
logs.state.partial: {status} Files not removed: {names}. Refresh the list and retry.
logs.state.cleared.other: Deleted {count} previous files. Current logging continues; this cannot be undone.
logs.state.cleared.one: Deleted {count} previous file. Current logging continues; this cannot be undone.
